author: Daniel Esquivel
text: In the 15+ countries I've been privileged to visit, this was the BEST food tour experience I've ever had. We enjoyed it so much, we immediately booked another tour with Simply Enak.

author: Andreas Moeckel
text: We have been living in Kuala Lumpur for eight months now and this was the deepest dive into local culture and cuisine we have experienced so far. You will end up sitting at a hawker stall, eating and talking like a local.

author: T Esp
text: This food trail and historical tour is a wonderful blend of local flavours and rich storytelling. Each stop pairs a delicious bite with thoughtful insights into the city's past, bringing its history to life in a natural, engaging way.

author: Simon Brodie
text: We did the KL Street Food Walk with Danny this morning. We had an amazing time — Danny shared not only so much tasty food but also the hidden secrets of KL back lanes. We saw amazing street art, and found the coolest bookshop we've ever seen.

author: Sushil Kaur
text: The Secrets of KL Food Tour led by Pauline was an amazing experience for our group of 10 senior ladies. She shared interesting stories and the history of the places she took us through Petaling Street. She took great care to ensure we all had a wonderful time.

author: Tim Scholes
text: Our family of 4 had a fantastic time with Danny on the street food tour. It was a great mix of good food and learning about the history of Chinatown. There was plenty of good food for both adults and fussy children.

author: Kathryn Stucky
text: After five years in KL, I thought I knew Chinatown — until I joined Simply Enak's food tour. Pauline navigated the maze of street stalls with ease, pointing out local favourites and hidden gems I'd never have found on my own.

author: tina witt
text: Pauline was the best guide! It is Chinese New Year and Ramadan, so it was very busy. Pauline made sure we didn't have to wait long for anything. She showed us all kinds of food and was very knowledgeable.

author: Alicia Hiew
text: Pauline was an awesome guide for our food tour around Old KL. Even though it was super humid, she made the walk really fun with her friendly vibe and great stories. We stopped at some amazing spots for food, drinks, and little hidden gems.
